title: Urban Traffic Congestion Monitoring
description: The city experiences severe traffic congestion during peak hours, costing an estimated $2.3M annually in lost productivity. We need real-time monitoring and predictive analytics to optimize signal timing and route management.

title: Smart Waste Collection Optimization
description: Current waste collection routes are static and inefficient, leading to overflowing bins in some areas and unnecessary pickups in others. Looking for IoT-based monitoring and route optimization solutions.

title: Water Quality Real-Time Monitoring
description: Multiple water quality incidents have occurred in the past year due to delayed detection. Need continuous monitoring sensors and an alert system across the municipal water supply network.

title: Public Safety Incident Response
description: Emergency response times average 12 minutes, above the 8-minute target. Need a predictive deployment system that positions resources based on historical incident patterns and real-time data.

title: Energy Efficiency in Municipal Buildings
description: Municipal buildings consume 40% more energy than comparable private sector buildings. Seeking smart building management solutions to reduce consumption and carbon footprint.

title: Citizen Service Portal Modernization
description: Current citizen services portal has a 35% abandonment rate. Need a modern, accessible digital platform that simplifies permit applications, payments, and service requests.

title: Stormwater Management System
description: Flooding during heavy rain events causes significant property damage. Need predictive flood modeling and smart drainage control systems to mitigate urban flooding risks.

title: Air Quality Monitoring Network
description: Limited air quality data makes it difficult to enforce regulations and inform citizens. Need a distributed sensor network providing real-time AQI data and health advisories.
